title: VIXEN configure requires manual FetchContent cache quarantine after stale HarfBuzz source
body: The first queued configure failed because .tmp/fetch/harfbuzz-src was stale/partially modified; I manually moved it to .tmp/fetch-baseline-failed-1 and configured with a fresh .tmp/fetch-baseline-2. The facade/provider setup should provision or quarantine stale FetchContent sources itself.

title: VIXEN configure requires explicit Undertow root when auto-derivation is disabled
body: The documented paired configure failed with VIXEN_AUTO_DERIVE_UNDERTOW_ROOT=OFF until UNDERTOW_ROOT=/home/liory/projects/undertow was supplied manually. The provider contract should expose or derive this dependency without a manual environment override.

title: VIXEN provider revision validation requires a full exact SHA before service generation
body: The first service-provider configure attempt failed on a non-40-character revision and had to be corrected manually to 08a5b420a744b110dd8f3ce132606ecb45aa9255. The provider pin/setup surface should make the exact paired revision available without a manual correction loop.

title: Recipe service target did not inherit C++23 for generated std::span sources
body: The first provider service-library build failed because generated RecipeGpuService.g.cpp uses std::span while the new target had no C++ standard set. I had to add target_compile_features(... cxx_std_23) manually; provider service target setup should carry the consumer standard contract automatically.

title: with-test-lock can report a transient missing flow status file during an admitted test
body: The queued RecipeServices test completed green, but with-test-lock.sh first printed line 4131: /tmp/undertow-box-flow-3220504.status: No such file or directory before admission. The queue should create/read its flow status marker atomically so successful witnesses do not carry an unexplained provisioning warning.

title: with-test-lock can lose its temporary wait marker during admitted targeted tests
body: The queued Recipe targeted-test command completed green, but with-test-lock.sh printed line 4003: /tmp/undertow-box-queue.wait.3294213: No such file or directory. Queue wait-marker cleanup should be atomic and should not emit a false diagnostic during an admitted run.

title: with-test-lock diagnostic breaker rejects a corrected identical retry
body: A queued test target compile failed on a source-only missing include, then the corrected retry with the same payload was refused as DIAGNOSTIC_REUSED until --no-breaker was supplied. The queue should key diagnostics to the source/input state or expose a source-aware retry path so corrected code does not need a breaker override.

title: VIXEN merge can import stale recipe SIMD output for the pinned kernel
body: After merging origin/wave/authoring-convergence, the final VIXEN build stopped at recipe_simd_check because checked-in RecipeSimd.g.hpp differed from the explicit kernel provider pin 08a5b420a744b110dd8f3ce132606ecb45aa9255. The documented recipe_simd_regen had to be run manually before the consumer build could proceed; merge/codegen should validate or regenerate the pinned generated artifact automatically.
